text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: So this is the ocean... It looks like it's really fun!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここが海なのね……
すごーく楽しそう！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: How am I supposed to play? There's so much I don't know. I'd be happy if you could teach me a lot of things.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうやって遊べばいいのかしら？
分からないことばっかり。
色々と教えてくれると嬉しいわ。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's go. I'm sure the experience here will be a fun memory.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さあ、
行きましょう。
きっとここでの経験も、
楽しい思い出になるはずだから。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Let's have as much fun as we can!
text_block_list.orig_text:
思いっきり、
楽しみましょう！
